text.title: AI LLM Workload Architecture — Output Contract
text.summary: The spec is one JSON document with one section per rule in 01-core-rules.xml: a version-pinned eval set, a deterministic scoring function (judge pinned at temperature 0 with a hashed prompt), numeric per-metric thresholds against a recorded baseline run, a merge-blocking CI gate on watched prompt / model / retrieval / tool paths, a dated production model id, p95 latency and per-request budgets, one injection case per untrusted channel, and a degradation path exercised by an eval case. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: the LLM-backed feature the spec covers (RAG answerer, agent, summariser, chat)
path plus git ref or content hash as `eval_set_ref`; contamination_check_passed true (r-eval-set-version-pinned)
kind exact-match | regex | json-schema | unit-assertion | llm-judge; a judge carries a dated model_id, temperature 0 and prompt_hash (r-scoring-function-deterministic)
url and commit of the run thresholds are relative to; the url also appears in evidence[] (r-thresholds-numeric-against-baseline)
per metric: baseline score, tolerance, threshold, direction; all numeric (r-thresholds-numeric-against-baseline)
ci_job, blocks_merge true, watched_paths covering prompts, model config, retrieval config and tool schemas; prompts_in_version_control true (r-regression-gate-blocks-merge)
dated (YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD) or explicitly versioned id; never an alias ending in latest (r-model-id-pinned)
p95_latency_ms and a per-request tokens or cost_usd ceiling, both measured in the eval run (r-latency-and-cost-budgets)
every retrieval source, tool output and the user turn, each with at least one injection eval case id (r-injection-cases-in-eval-set)
bounded retry with backoff, a fallback kind, the user-visible message, and the eval case ids that exercise the fallback (r-degradation-path-defined)
URLs: baseline run, latest gated CI run, calibration of the judge noise floor

forbidden.pattern: eval_set.ref missing, a notebook path, or an eval input string present in any prompt file (fm-eval-contamination)
scoring.kind llm-judge with judge.model_id ending in latest, temperature above 0, or no prompt_hash (fm-judge-drift)
a metric without a numeric baseline and threshold, or a threshold phrased as prose (fm-vibes-threshold)
production_model_id without a date or version suffix (fm-silent-model-swap)
regression_gate.blocks_merge false, or watched_paths that omit the directory the prompts actually live in (fm-gate-bypassed-by-config-edit)
an untrusted_input_channels[] entry with zero injection_case_ids
budgets present but measured_in_eval_run false — a budget nobody measures is a wish

allowed-transformations.transformation: Record several retrieval sources that share one index as one channel whose name lists the sources, as long as at least one injection case targets that index.
Where the vendor exposes only an alias, pin by recording the snapshot id the vendor maps it to on the eval date and treat any remap as a model change.
Express the cost budget in tokens when pricing changes faster than the spec is reviewed; the direction of the gate is the same.

list.item: eval_set.ref is a git ref or content hash, the path is not a notebook, and the contamination grep passed.
scoring is exact-match / regex / json-schema / unit-assertion, or an llm-judge with a dated model_id, temperature 0, a sha256 prompt_hash and a measured noise_floor.
Every metric has numeric baseline, tolerance, threshold and direction; baseline_run.url is in evidence[].
regression_gate blocks merge and watches the prompt, model config, retrieval config and tool-schema paths; prompts live in version control.
production_model_id and every fallback or judge model_id carry a date or version suffix, none ends in latest.
budgets state p95_latency_ms and a per-request tokens or cost_usd ceiling, and the eval run measures both.
Every untrusted channel (each retrieval source, each tool, the user turn) lists at least one injection case id.
degradation.retry is bounded with backoff; the fallback is exercised by at least one eval case; the user message is written.
